result.instructions: Tools for Lengow, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which marketplace orders came in this week and are not shipped yet?"; "Show order 1234-ABC from Amazon with its lines and delivery address."; "Did the last ship action for order 1234-ABC succeed on the marketplace?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Lengow data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run lengow_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run lengow_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run lengow_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. lengow_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: lengow_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List marketplace orders of the account with their status, lines and customer delivery data. Without a date filter, Lengow returns only the last 7 days. Use it to find orders to ship or check. Lengow API: GET /v3.0/orders/.

merchant_order_id.description: Your internal order id, set with lengow_set_merchant_order_id.

lengow_status.description: Lengow order status, for example "accepted" or "shipped".

marketplace_order_date_from.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time with offset, for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00.

marketplace_order_date_to.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time with offset, for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00.

updated_from.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time with offset, for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00.

updated_to.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time with offset, for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00.

tools.name: lengow_list_order_actions
tools.title: List order actions
tools.description: List the actions sent to marketplaces (accept, ship, cancel and others) with their result. Use it after an action to see whether the marketplace processed it: processed=true and queued=false means success; errors names the failure. Lengow API: GET /v3.0/orders/actions/.

processed.description: true = processed by the marketplace, false = failed or not yet processed.

queued.description: true = Lengow is still retrying the action.

created_from.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time with offset, for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00.

created_to.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time with offset, for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00.

updated_from.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time with offset, for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00.

updated_to.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time with offset, for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00.

tools.name: lengow_list_marketplaces
tools.title: List marketplaces
tools.description: List the connected marketplaces with their codes, order statuses, the actions each allows and the required fields of each action (for example the carriers for ship). Call it before lengow_create_order_action. Lengow API: GET /v3.0/marketplaces/.

tools.name: lengow_set_merchant_order_id
tools.title: Set merchant order id
tools.description: Store your own internal order id on a Lengow order, so later imports can skip it. Safe to repeat with the same values. Lengow API: PATCH /v3.0/orders/moi/.

merchant_order_id.description: Your internal order id(s), as an array of strings.

tools.name: lengow_create_order_action
tools.title: Create an order action
tools.description: Send an accept or ship action for one order to its marketplace. Lengow runs it asynchronously and retries it up to 5 times: check the result with lengow_list_order_actions. Ship needs tracking_number (and carrier when the marketplace requires it: see lengow_list_marketplaces). Lengow API: POST /v3.0/orders/actions/.

action_type.description: accept = accept the order; ship = mark it as shipped.

line.description: marketplace_order_line_id, for a partial action on one line.
